**Handoff is written to `INCIDENT-HANDOFF.md`.**

Root cause is `gateway.pool.perRequest` going `false -> true`. Every request grabs its own connection now. The pool of 20 saturates and never drains. Roll back `dep-4471`, the gateway config deploy.

Impact ran 02:14:18Z to 03:59:27Z and had not recovered. 530 of 636 requests failed. Only `/health` stayed green, which is why the page came 67 minutes late.

Two things I flagged for the next shift. 106 `/v1/profile` requests logged no result at all. And these logs are dated March 14, not last night.
